These studies look back at the largest up and down days since the SpaceX
listing on June 12, 2026. Each one applies the journal's method to a day whose
outcome is already known: what moved, which channel drove it, what happened
over the following five trading days, and what the episode teaches.

::: {.callout-note title="How these differ from journal entries" icon=false}
Journal entries are written before the outcome is known and carry a scored
prediction. Case studies are written afterwards, so they contain no
prediction and are kept out of the scored record. Their purpose is to build
a library of mechanisms to draw on when writing live entries.
:::
